title: SalesFramework
description: A named sales methodology expressed as data (SPICED, MEDDPICC, BANT, Command of the Message, Gap Selling, Sandler, Next Steps). Frameworks give scorecards and the coach a shared, citable vocabulary. They are deliberately neutral summaries of public methodologies, paraphrased for reuse.

origin.description: Attribution to the methodology's originator(s), for credit and further reading.

best_for.description: Call types / motions where this framework shines.

elements.description: The building blocks of the framework (e.g. the letters of the acronym).

question.description: The core question this element answers about the deal.

example_questions.description: Discovery questions a rep can ask to satisfy this element.
